title: Buttermilk Herb Ranch Dressing
summary: Buttermilk and mayonnaise whisked with chives, dill, parsley, garlic and a dash of vinegar, then chilled until lightly thickened.

ingredients.item: fresh dill, finely chopped, plus a sprig to serve
garlic cloves, grated to a paste
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Whisk the base
steps.text: Put the buttermilk and mayonnaise in the bowl and whisk until completely smooth with no streaks of mayonnaise left.

steps.title: Add the herbs
steps.text: Stir in the chopped chives, dill and parsley along with the garlic paste, vinegar, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 min. The herbs release their flavour into the dressing, and the cold firms it to a coating consistency.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Give it a stir and taste for salt. Pour into a serving bowl, add a dill sprig on top and serve with carrot sticks and other crisp raw vegetables, or spoon over a crunchy salad.

tips: For a thicker dip, cut the buttermilk to 80 ml; for a pourable salad dressing, add a splash more.
Chop the herbs finely with a sharp knife so they stay green rather than bruised.
Swap the parsley for coriander for a fresher, slightly citrusy version.
A pinch of cayenne gives a gentle background warmth.
storage: Keep in a covered jar in the fridge for up to 2 days; shake or stir before using. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
